verses.1: Hear this: The house of Jacob, which is called Israel, and from among the Jews, those who are called righteous, will remember God and the gods of Israel, but not in truth or righteousness.
verses.2: For those who are called “the Holy City,” and for the gods of Israel, Jehovah’s armies will be invoked.
verses.3: From the beginning, I have spoken these words. They came from my mouth, and suddenly I did them. And they became real.
verses.4: I know that it’s difficult for you, and that you’re being cut by iron. Your skin is torn apart from the pain.
verses.5: And I will tell you from now on, before you hear it. So that you won’t say, “My heart is broken, and my soul is in pain.”
verses.6: You have heard all this from Hazeya. But you yourselves do not know these new things and revelations that have been given to you. You do not understand them at all.
verses.7: Now they were created, and ever since then, and before tomorrow, they have not heard this. Then it will be said to them, “Now you know.”
verses.8: Nor did you hear it, nor did you know it. Nor did you open your ears, because I knew from the beginning that there was sin and wickedness among you.
verses.9: So that my name may be remembered, and my song may be sung in praise of you.
verses.10: Behold, you have been bought with a price, not with silver. You are precious in my eyes.
verses.11: For my sake, I will do it. For how can I stop? My honor is at stake; I must do this no matter what.
verses.12: Hear me, Jacob! And let Israel be blessed. I am the first, and I will also be the last.
verses.13: My right hand established the earth; my left hand raised the heavens. I call to them, and they will stand together.
verses.14: May you all be filled with joy, and listen to who among them says these words. Jehovah will do as He desires in Babylon, and may their descendants become like weeds.
verses.15: I, I have spoken. Even if they call him “Bring him here”, may he succeed in his journey.
verses.16: Come to me, listen to this. It wasn’t from the mouth of a prophet that I spoke these words. I was there when they were still there. Now, O LORD, send your spirit and your power.
verses.17: As Jehovah has said, “May the Holy Israel be saved! I, Jehovah your God, will teach you how to use your abilities in the way that is right.”
verses.18: If you would only obey my commands, then your peace and righteousness would be like rivers that flow endlessly.
verses.19: And your descendants will be like this: they will not be recognized, nor will their names be remembered before me.
verses.20: Let them come out of Babylon! Let them flee from their enemies with a loud cry. Let them spread the news throughout the land. Say, “May Jehovah save His servant Jacob!”
verses.21: And they did not suffer in those disasters when they were thrown into the water from the abyss. The abyss collapsed, and they were drowned in the water.
verses.22: There is no peace, said Jehovah to the wicked.
